title: docket validate JSON-lines problem
description: One problem emitted by `docket validate --json`. A clean recipe emits nothing at all and exits 0; each problem is one line and the command exits 1. See docs/json-output.md.

version.description: Wire-format version. Branch on this before reading any other field.

code.description: Stable machine key for the problem category.

play.description: Play label, e.g. `play #1` or the play's name. Absent on problems that precede play parsing.

task.description: Task label, e.g. `task #2 "create app"`. Absent on play-level and file-level problems.

line.description: 1-indexed line in the recipe. Absent when the problem has no source position. For a JSON5 recipe this indexes into the normalised YAML form, not the JSON5 source.

hint.description: Optional remediation hint, e.g. a did-you-mean suggestion for a misspelled task type.
